title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Quick answers to the most common questions about our events, community, and how to get involved.

items.question: Who attends your events?
items.answer: Our events bring together senior leaders, founders, innovators, creatives, and decision-makers across the media, entertainment, and technology industries.

items.question: Are your events invite-only?
items.answer: Yes. We curate each event to ensure a balanced, senior, and relevant mix of attendees to encourage meaningful conversations and peer-level networking.

items.question: How can I get invited?
items.answer: You can register your interest through our website. We take into account industry background, seniority, and interests to match attendees with the right events.

items.question: Do you work with partners?
items.answer: Yes. We collaborate with organisations aligned to our mission to create thoughtful, high-quality industry experiences. Partnerships are selective and values-led.
